entities.summary: Batavia, known in Dutch as Betuwe, is a historical and geographical region in the Netherlands, composed of large fertile islands in the river delta formed by the waters of the Rhine and Meuse rivers. During the Roman Empire, it was an important frontier region and source of imperial soldiers. Its name is possibly pre-Roman.
